description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role is with a facility committed to providing outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are seeking a visionary leader who can uphold high standards of operational excellence and clinical quality.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You will oversee daily operations, financial performance, and staff development, playing a pivotal role in shaping the facility's future and enhancing the lives of its residents.This position offers a competitive salary package, reflecting the importance of this leadership role. Join a team dedicated to making a significant impact in the healthcare community.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Proven track record of successful operational and financial management.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
